selection: Authored C/header/Makefile files and original bitmap resources retained; bundled compiled archive/dependencies/VCS/OS metadata omitted.

files.reason: Convert bits per pixel to bytes for framebuffer mapping, double-buffer allocation and presentation. Original 1280x1024x16 requested 20971520 bytes rather than 2621440, failing the aperture map and over-copying framebuffer data.
files.verification: Actual initializer RED fails independent exact-byte range assertion. Corrected owning function maps expected1280x1024x2 bytes and presents every byte without crossing a guard page.

controlsRationale: Original menu number-key releases select two, three or four local players. Space release starts, pauses and resumes; first rider A/D and second rider Left/Right turn counterclockwise/clockwise. Two horizontal direction pads expose these four verified controls; the optional keyboard retains original third/fourth-player menu access. Explicit relative path alias preserves authored bitmap paths.

artwork.icon: Simple cyan and gold bent lightcycle trails use the original two-player colors and dark grid motif. No upstream art changed.
artwork.preview: Actual original two-player arena after touch turns, scaled from 1280x1024 to 640x512.

verification.browser: Real CDP touch in landscape 844x390 and portrait 390x844: two-player menu, Start, both riders turn in both directions, visible independent cyan/gold trails, Pause and Resume; Game running, errors[].
verification.ndk: All seven authored Makefile C translation units pass NDK27 ARM64 syntax compilation.
verification.sourceRegression: Real vg_init map range is independently 1280*1024*2 bytes; guard-page framebuffer receives all and only declared frame bytes via paint_buff. RED before correction, GREEN after.
